summary: Coordinate SDG partners, select shared indicators and prepare progress briefs. Explore this practical five-day foundation course.
lede: Cross-sector SDG training helps programme coordinators, policy analysts and sustainability practitioners align multi-partner initiatives with shared development outcomes. Participants learn to map contributions to relevant targets, build a joint Theory of Change and select indicators with baselines and data-quality checks. They also practise clarifying partner roles and preparing progress briefs that show evidence gaps, dependencies and decisions.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who coordinate, measure or support initiatives involving more than one sector and need practical ways to connect activities with SDG targets and shared outcomes.
modules: Theory of Change for Joint Action
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with a project, programme or policy initiative is useful. No coding is required.
